name: Silver of the Waves

aliases: what is silver of the waves
faq.answer: You find the tarnished silver hair clip among discarded fishing debris, then seek its owner. The piece bears the initials K.D.
faq.q: What is Silver of the Waves?

faq.answer: The hair clip bears the initials K.D. Its owner recognizes it when you return it, and is grateful to recover a keepsake thought gone forever.
faq.q: Whose hair clip is found in the debris?

aliases: where was the hair clip found
faq.answer: The hair clip lies among discarded fishing debris, near broken wire spools and rusty hooks. The entry does not say exactly where it was lost.
faq.q: Where was the hair clip lost?

faq.answer: The ornate silver hair clip is tarnished by moisture and weather, but its craftsmanship remains visible. A little polishing will restore its shine.
faq.q: What condition is the hair clip in?

aliases: how do you start silver of the waves
faq.answer: You find the monogrammed hair clip among discarded fishing refuse, broken wire spools, and rusty hooks. Then you seek its owner.
The owner had thought the keepsake lost to the water for good. Its return brings relief, and the grateful owner welcomes the recovery of a treasured possession.
faq.q: Why is returning the hair clip significant?

sections.body: Among discarded fishing debris, you find an ornate silver hair clip marked with the initials K.D. Rusted hooks and broken wire spools lie nearby. Moisture has tarnished the clip, but its fine work still shows beneath the corrosion.
sections.title: A Keepsake in the Flotsam

sections.body: The clip belongs to a hardworking local, busy with daily chores. You return the keepsake, which its owner had thought lost to the water for good. A little polishing will restore its shine, and the grateful owner welcomes its return.
sections.title: Restoring the Shine

summary: A lost silver hair clip waits among fishing debris, and its owner is caught up in daily chores. Its return brings relief and restores a keepsake thought lost to the water.
attribution: In-game quest text: Silver of the Waves
